title: DengueSeq: A pan-serotype whole genome amplicon sequencing protocol for dengue virus
author: Chantal Vogels
materials: When program is complete, samples can remain in the thermocycler at 4°C or be stored at -20°C Briefly centrifuge tubes before use This is a safe stopping point. Amplicons can be stored long-term at -20°C.
When the program is complete, immediately remove the tubes from the thermocycler Briefly centrifuge tubes

steps.title: Organize primers into pools
steps.instruction: Separate odd-numbered primers into Pool 1 and even-numbered primers into Pool 2 for each serotype; label accordingly.

steps.title: Resuspend lyophilized primers
steps.instruction: Resuspend each lyophilized primer to 100 µM in nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Prepare primer dilution tubes
steps.instruction: Add 90 µL nuclease‑free water to each of two 8‑strip PCR tubes per serotype, label the tube tops with the primer identifier, then add 10 µL of the 100 µM primer to reach a 10 µM working concentration; mix by vortex or a fresh tip.

steps.title: Create working primer solutions
steps.instruction: Transfer 10 µL of each 10 µM primer into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes (8 tubes total, 2 per serotype, one for Pool 1 and one for Pool 2); label tubes with serotype, pool number, concentration, and date; store at –20 °C.

steps.title: First‑strand cDNA synthesis
steps.instruction: In new PCR tubes add 8.5 µL EPH3 HT, then 8.5 µL RNA sample (or 8.5 µL nuclease‑free water for the cDNA NTC), mix 10× up‑and‑down, briefly centrifuge, and run the first‑strand cDNA thermocycler program as specified.

steps.title: Second‑strand cDNA synthesis
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix for the number of reactions (volumes per reaction as given in the protocol), add 8 µL master mix to each tube, mix 10×, centrifuge, and run the second‑strand cDNA thermocycler program; store cDNA at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare serotype‑specific PCR mixes
steps.instruction: For each serotype, prepare separate Pool 1 and Pool 2 PCR master mixes according to the number of samples, including one extra reaction for a PCR NTC.

steps.title: Distribute PCR master mixes
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of the appropriate Pool 1 master mix to a new set of PCR tubes (one per sample) and 20 µL of the Pool 2 master mix to another set; include an extra tube for the PCR NTC in each pool; match master‑mix serotype to the sample.

steps.title: Add cDNA to PCR reactions
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL cDNA to each Pool 1 and Pool 2 tube; add 5 µL nuclease‑free water to the NTC tubes; mix 10×, briefly centrifuge.

steps.title: Amplify amplicons
steps.instruction: Run the PCR thermocycler program as described in the protocol.

steps.title: Quantify amplicons
steps.instruction: Measure each amplicon pool on a Qubit fluorometer to confirm successful amplification.

steps.title: Prepare library‑prep master mix
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of the library‑prep master mix to a new PCR tube for each sample.

steps.title: Combine amplicon pools
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Pool 1 amplicon and 10 µL Pool 2 amplicon to the corresponding master‑mix tube, mix 10×, centrifuge; store any remaining amplicon pools at –20 °C.

steps.title: Tagmentation reaction
steps.instruction: Run the thermocycler program for tagmentation as specified in the protocol.

steps.title: Add ST2 reagent
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL ST2 to each tube, mix, briefly centrifuge, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: First magnetic bead wash
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic stand until the liquid clears, discard supernatant without touching the beads, add 100 µL TWB HT, mix 10×, centrifuge, and avoid introducing bubbles.

steps.title: Second magnetic bead wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash with another 100 µL TWB HT; after mixing, keep the tubes on the magnetic stand without discarding the supernatant yet.

steps.title: Add dual‑indexed adapters
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL master mix containing dual‑barcoded index adapters to each tube, briefly centrifuge the plate, clean the sealing foil with RNase Away then 70 % EtOH, add 10 µL dual‑coded index adapters, mix 10×, centrifuge.

steps.title: Index PCR
steps.instruction: Run the thermocycler program for indexed PCR; after completion, hold at 10 °C or store at –20 °C (safe stopping point).

steps.title: Post‑PCR bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic stand, discard supernatant, add 1000 µL 80 % EtOH, incubate 30 seconds at room temperature; repeat the EtOH wash, remove residual EtOH with a smaller pipette, add RSB HT (30 µL for 1‑24 samples, 40 µL for 25‑48, 50 µL for 49‑96), vortex, briefly centrifuge, incubate 2 minutes at room temperature, place on magnetic stand, and transfer (total volume – 5 µL) to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Final library quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the final library on a Qubit and assess fragment‑size distribution using a Bioanalyzer or TapeStation.

steps.title: Pool libraries and size‑select
steps.instruction: Combine equal volumes of each library into a new 1.5 mL tube (multichannel into an 8‑strip of 0.2 mL PCR tubes then transfer); calculate ITB volume as 0.9 × total pooled volume, add the calculated ITB, vortex 10 seconds, centrifuge, incubate 5 minutes at room temperature, place on a magnetic stand, discard supernatant, add 1000 µL 80 % EtOH, incubate 30 seconds, repeat EtOH wash, add RSB HT (30 µL for ≤24 samples, 40 µL for 25‑48, 50 µL for 49‑96), vortex, centrifuge, incubate 2 minutes, place on magnetic stand, transfer (total volume – 5 µL) to a new tube, then quantify on Qubit and run Bioanalyzer/TapeStation for final QC.
